author: vladthegreat100
body:
Hey there Officials, y'all probably have come since you saw the title.
NOTE: This is not meant to offend you guys but you truly have to get your act together.

You guys have had many issues with tournaments in the past, but imo this is the worst that you guys have ever done in a tourney.

First thing that is bad, you guys weren't able to inform us that in the games we needed 1.8. For god's sake the server is suppose to be immigrating to 1.8 soon and you have us play 1.7 in the tourney??? Got Kaldorei and I'm sure a bunch of other teams struggling to change their minecraft versions thinking its "last second" which comes to my next point.

Second, you guys weren't able to stick to schedule. In your post you are saying that teams should be on teamspeak and ready to play and that we will be considered a no show after a few minutes... Well while I'm writing this it's been 45 minutes after the time Kaldorei vs Quedizii were suppose to play... I'm being told that there is a lack of "refs" which come to the last point:

Last of all, apparently you guys are "low on refs" but why is this? You've had a good month now to get ready and get all of your refs ready, and I've seen how it's been going on in the slack, last minute callouts, and even when you guys are late you aren't communicating in the slack to see if you can get refs to get on. The last message on the slack up to present while I write this post was at 12:00 in the private media group where they were asking for streamers to get on. Otherwise 0 communication.

In the end, my point is that you guys should just get your act together, inform every player about anything, even if it may seem little, the 1.7 is a big thing since most of the players on avicus play on 1.8, try to stick on schedule and don't say that matches will start "asap", I was told that and 30 minutes later nothing and make sure to communicate, if you guys are low on refs/officials don't wait on a game or two to end to continue the next match, communicate through slack to get people who never confirmed. Maybe something changed in their life but they never said so since they thought it was late.

I suggest re-scheduling all the games that have not been played. Because finishing this post its been an hour from 12 EST, the time that every game needed to start.
PLEASE be more organized for next week or next matches.

Also time wanted me to add that TimePie & Emily are dating now :]
Have a nice day!!!

we also had the issue of peeps playing and reffing at the same time. Even if there's no bias involved, it is reasonable to say that many people don't trust it.
